title: getConfig
description:
Read the plugin's current configuration.

Secrets must come back redacted or omitted. The core stores configuration on the plugin's behalf and has no need to read a password back out; a plugin that echoes one has leaked it into the core's logs.

schema.title: JSON Schema for the config
schema.description: Lets the core render a settings form without reading plugin.yaml. Optional — the manifest remains the authoritative copy.
